steps.name: environment
steps.description: Create a non-root developer user, ensure workspace exists and is owned by that user, create per-user npm-global directory, persist an idempotent /etc/profile.d script that exports NODE_ENV and conditionally prepends the user's npm-global bin to PATH. Validate node and npm versions; if Node major is <18 emit a clear remediation message with detected versions and required action (do not attempt to change image).
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/native-notes-app-197439-197458/notes_native_app"
DEVUSER=devuser
DEVHOME="/home/$DEVUSER"
LOGDIR="$WORKSPACE/logs"
sudo mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" "$LOGDIR" && sudo chown -R "$DEVUSER":"$DEVUSER" "$WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null || true
# create devuser if missing
if ! id -u "$DEVUSER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo useradd -m -s /bin/bash "$DEVUSER"; fi
# ensure npm-global owned by devuser
sudo -u "$DEVUSER" bash -lc "mkdir -p '$DEVHOME/.npm-global/bin' && chmod 0755 '$DEVHOME/.npm-global' || true"
sudo chown -R "$DEVUSER":"$DEVUSER" "$DEVHOME/.npm-global" || true
# idempotent /etc/profile.d entry using DEVHOME variable
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/notes_native_env.sh
sudo bash -lc "cat > '$PROFILE' <<'EOF'
# notes_native_app development environment
export NODE_ENV=development
DEVHOME=${DEVHOME}
if [ -d "${DEVHOME}/.npm-global/bin" ] && ! echo \":\$PATH:\" | grep -q \":${DEVHOME}/.npm-global/bin:\"; then
  export PATH="${DEVHOME}/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"
fi
EOF
" >/dev/null
sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"
# Validate node and npm
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: node or npm not found on PATH. Ensure container has nodejs and npm available (preinstalled image expected)." >&2; exit 2; fi
NODE_VER_RAW=$(node --version 2>/dev/null || true)
NPM_VER_RAW=$(npm --version 2>/dev/null || true)
# strip leading v
NODE_VER=${NODE_VER_RAW#v}
NODE_MAJOR=$(echo "$NODE_VER" | cut -d. -f1 || echo 0)
if [ -z "$NODE_MAJOR" ] || [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 18 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Unsupported Node.js version detected: $NODE_VER_RAW (npm $NPM_VER_RAW). This setup requires Node >=18.0.0.\nREMEDIATION: Run the agent with an image providing Node >=18, or install a compatible Node locally (e.g., nvm) before continuing. Do not proceed automatically within this container." >&2
  exit 3
fi
# report versions
echo "node=$NODE_VER_RAW" > "$LOGDIR/env_versions.txt"
echo "npm=$NPM_VER_RAW" >> "$LOGDIR/env_versions.txt"
exit 0

steps.name: install dependencies
steps.description: Install project dependencies (local) in workspace as devuser. Use npm ci if lockfile exists, otherwise npm i. Capture logs to workspace/logs. After install verify expected local binaries exist. Detect common native build failures (node-gyp / sqlite3) by scanning logs and provide clear remediation instructions for system packages (libsqlite3-dev, python3-dev, pkg-config) rather than attempting image-level installs.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/native-notes-app-197439-197458/notes_native_app"
DEVUSER=devuser
LOGDIR="$WORKSPACE/logs"
sudo -u "$DEVUSER" bash -lc "mkdir -p '$LOGDIR' '$WORKSPACE' || true"
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ]; then echo "ERROR: package.json missing in $WORKSPACE" >&2; exit 2; fi
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/package-lock.json" ]; then INSTALL_CMD='npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --no-progress'; else INSTALL_CMD='npm i --no-audit --no-fund --no-progress'; fi
sudo -u "$DEVUSER" bash -lc "cd '$WORKSPACE' && echo 'Running: $INSTALL_CMD' > '$LOGDIR/npm-install.log' && $INSTALL_CMD 2>&1 | tee -a '$LOGDIR/npm-install.log'"
# verify local binaries
MISSING=0
if [ ! -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/electron-packager" ]; then echo "ERROR: electron-packager not found after install" >&2; MISSING=1; fi
if [ ! -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/jest" ]; then echo "ERROR: jest not found after install" >&2; MISSING=1; fi
if [ "$MISSING" -eq 1 ]; then echo "See $LOGDIR/npm-install.log for details" >&2; exit 3; fi
# quick sanity require check for sqlite3 and capture failure log
sudo -u "$DEVUSER" bash -lc "cd '$WORKSPACE' && node -e 'try{require("sqlite3");console.log("sqlite3 module present");}catch(e){console.error("SQLITE_REQUIRE_ERROR",e && e.message);process.exit(5)}'" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOGDIR/sqlite-check.log" || true
# scan for common gyp/sqlite errors
if grep -E "gyp|node-gyp|make:|error:|SQLITE_REQUIRE_ERROR" -i "$LOGDIR/npm-install.log" >/dev/null 2>&1 || grep -E "gyp|node-gyp|error" -i "$LOGDIR/sqlite-check.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: Detected native build failures in npm install. Common remediation: install system build deps: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libsqlite3-dev pkg-config python3-dev build-essential" >&2
  echo "Also ensure node-gyp prerequisites (Python, make, g++) are present. See $LOGDIR/npm-install.log and $LOGDIR/sqlite-check.log" >&2
  exit 4
fi
exit 0

steps.name: validation: build, start, stop
steps.description: Build/package the app using local electron-packager into a deterministic dist directory, locate the platform-specific binary path robustly, run ldd to show missing shared libs (if any), start the packaged binary in the container's DISPLAY (:99) as devuser capturing stdout/stderr to workspace/logs, verify the process is running, then terminate it cleanly. Provide dist path and logs as evidence. Fail gracefully with actionable remediation if GUI runtime libs missing.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/native-notes-app-197439-197458/notes_native_app"
DEVUSER=devuser
LOGDIR="$WORKSPACE/logs"
DIST="$WORKSPACE/dist"
mkdir -p "$LOGDIR" "$DIST"
export DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:99}
PKG_BIN="$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/electron-packager"
if [ ! -x "$PKG_BIN" ]; then echo "ERROR: electron-packager not found at $PKG_BIN" >&2; exit 2; fi
# run packager writing to known out dir
sudo -u "$DEVUSER" bash -lc "cd '$WORKSPACE' && '$PKG_BIN' . notes-native --platform=linux --arch=x64 --overwrite --out '$DIST' 2>&1" | tee -a "$LOGDIR/electron-packager.log"
# locate package folder e.g. dist/notes-native-linux-x64
PKG_DIR=$(find "$DIST" -maxdepth 2 -type d -name 'notes-native-linux-*' -print -quit || true)
if [ -z "$PKG_DIR" ]; then PKG_DIR=$(find "$DIST" -maxdepth 3 -type d -name 'notes-native*' -print -quit || true); fi
if [ -z "$PKG_DIR" ]; then echo "ERROR: packaging produced no package dir; see $LOGDIR/electron-packager.log" >&2; exit 3; fi
# determine app binary - common layout: PKG_DIR/notes-native or PKG_DIR/notes-native/notes-native
CANDIDATE=$(find "$PKG_DIR" -maxdepth 3 -type f -perm /111 -name 'notes-native*' -print -quit || true)
if [ -z "$CANDIDATE" ]; then
  # try name of directory
  APPNAME=$(basename "$PKG_DIR" | sed 's/-linux.*//')
  CANDIDATE=$(find "$PKG_DIR" -maxdepth 3 -type f -perm /111 -name "$APPNAME*" -print -quit || true)
fi
if [ -z "$CANDIDATE" ]; then echo "ERROR: no executable found in package dir $PKG_DIR" >&2; exit 4; fi
# preflight shared libs (ldd) to surface missing deps
LDD_OUT="$LOGDIR/ldd_$(basename "$CANDIDATE").log"
if command -v ldd >/dev/null 2>&1; then ldd "$CANDIDATE" > "$LDD_OUT" 2>&1 || true; fi
if grep -E "not found" -i "$LDD_OUT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: Missing shared libraries detected for packaged binary. See $LDD_OUT. REMEDY: install desktop runtime libs (e.g., libgtk-3-0, libnotify, libnss3, libx11-6, libxcomposite1, libxdamage1, libxrandr2, libgbm1, libasound2) into the container or run inside the VNC-enabled image." >&2; tail -n 200 "$LDD_OUT" >&2; exit 5; fi
# start the app as devuser, capture pid
APP_LOG="$LOGDIR/notes_native_app.run.log"
sudo -u "$DEVUSER" bash -lc "cd '$(printf '%q' "$PKG_DIR")' && nohup '$(printf '%q' "$CANDIDATE")' > '$(printf '%q' "$APP_LOG")' 2>&1 & echo \$!" > /tmp/notes_app.pid
sleep 2
if [ ! -s /tmp/notes_app.pid ]; then echo "ERROR: failed to start app; see $APP_LOG and $LOGDIR/electron-packager.log" >&2; [ -f "$APP_LOG" ] && tail -n 200 "$APP_LOG" >&2 || true; exit 6; fi
PID=$(cat /tmp/notes_app.pid)
if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then echo "ERROR: process $PID not running after start; see $APP_LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$APP_LOG" >&2 || true; exit 7; fi
# clean stop
kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
rm -f /tmp/notes_app.pid
# Evidence
echo "package_dir=$PKG_DIR"
echo "executable=$CANDIDATE"
echo "run_log=$APP_LOG"
exit 0

# locate package folder e.g. dist/notes-native-linux-x64
PKG_DIR=$(find "$DIST" -maxdepth 2 -type d -name 'notes-native-linux-*' -print -quit || true)
if [ -z "$PKG_DIR" ]; then
  PKG_DIR=$(find "$DIST" -maxdepth 3 -type d -name 'notes-native*' -print -quit || true)
fi
if [ -z "$PKG_DIR" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: packaging produced no package dir; see $LOGDIR/electron-packager.log" >&2
  exit 3
fi

# determine app binary - look for executable files matching app name patterns
CANDIDATE=$(find "$PKG_DIR" -maxdepth 3 -type f -perm /111 -name 'notes-native*' -print -quit || true)
if [ -z "$CANDIDATE" ]; then
  APPNAME=$(basename "$PKG_DIR" | sed 's/-linux.*//')
  CANDIDATE=$(find "$PKG_DIR" -maxdepth 3 -type f -perm /111 -name "$APPNAME*" -print -quit || true)
fi
if [ -z "$CANDIDATE" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: no executable found in package dir $PKG_DIR" >&2
  exit 4
fi

# preflight shared libs (ldd) to surface missing deps
LDD_OUT="$LOGDIR/ldd_$(basename "$CANDIDATE").log"
if command -v ldd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ldd "$CANDIDATE" > "$LDD_OUT" 2>&1 || true
else
  echo "WARNING: ldd not available; skipping shared library preflight" > "$LDD_OUT"
fi

if grep -E "not found" -i "$LDD_OUT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: Missing shared libraries detected for packaged binary. See $LDD_OUT." >&2
  echo "REMEDY: install desktop runtime libs into the container (e.g., sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libgtk-3-0 libnotify4 libnss3 libx11-6 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libasound2) or run inside a VNC-enabled image that already contains them." >&2
  echo "Tail of $LDD_OUT:" >&2
  tail -n 200 "$LDD_OUT" >&2 || true
  exit 5
fi

# start the app as devuser, capture pid and stdout/stderr
APP_LOG="$LOGDIR/notes_native_app.run.log"
# ensure previous log cleared
: > "$APP_LOG"
sudo -u "$DEVUSER" bash -lc "cd '$(printf '%q' "$PKG_DIR")' && nohup '$(printf '%q' "$CANDIDATE")' > '$(printf '%q' "$APP_LOG")' 2>&1 & echo \$!" > /tmp/notes_app.pid || true
sleep 2
if [ ! -s /tmp/notes_app.pid ]; then
  echo "ERROR: failed to start app; see $APP_LOG and $LOGDIR/electron-packager.log" >&2
  [ -f "$APP_LOG" ] && tail -n 200 "$APP_LOG" >&2 || true
  exit 6
fi
PID=$(cat /tmp/notes_app.pid)
if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "ERROR: process $PID not running after start; see $APP_LOG" >&2
  tail -n 200 "$APP_LOG" >&2 || true
  exit 7
fi

# clean stop
kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
rm -f /tmp/notes_app.pid

# Evidence output
echo "package_dir=$PKG_DIR"
echo "executable=$CANDIDATE"
echo "run_log=$APP_LOG"

exit 0

steps.summary:
Executed the validation step for build/start/stop. I created a single self-contained validation script (.init/validation.sh) based on the provided script, preserving strict error handling and idempotency. The script packages the app using the local electron-packager binary, locates the produced platform package directory and executable robustly, runs ldd on the binary and writes output to workspace/logs, starts the packaged binary as the non-root developer user (devuser) using the container DISPLAY (:99), captures stdout/stderr to logs, verifies the process is running, and then stops it cleanly. The script fails gracefully with a clear remediation message if GUI runtime libraries are missing (lists common packages such as libgtk-3-0, libnotify, libnss3, libx11-6, libxcomposite1, libxdamage1, libxrandr2, libgbm1, libasound2). The script writes these artifacts for evidence: electron-packager log, ldd log, run log, and prints package_dir, executable, and run_log on success. It exits with non-zero codes for common failure modes and provides actionable remediation messages in stderr for missing packager binary, packaging failures, missing executable, missing shared libs, and failed start. No architect escalation required unless the container is missing required OS GUI runtime libs, in which case the remediation message tells the engineer to install runtime packages or run inside a VNC-enabled image that already contains them.

Note: This step assumes previous steps (env/scaffold/install/test) have run and that electron-packager and project files are present under the workspace path. The script uses the workspace path from the container info and runs packaging as devuser. Logs are placed in workspace/logs and package output in workspace/dist.
